texts.input: Aise scenarios bataiye jinmein nirdesh "Go outside" ke alag-alag matlab/iraade ho sakte hain
texts.output_1:
1. Tehelne jaana, ya toh akele ya doston ke saath.
2. Kisi park ya dusri baahari jagah par koi game khelne ya kisi gatividhi mein shaamil hone ke liye jaana.
3. Thodi taazi hawa ya dhoop lene jaana.
4. Ghar ya office ke bahar kaam par jaana.
5. Kisi dukaan ya dusre commercial establishment mein jaana jo bahar sthit hai.
6. Ghar se bahar jaana aur phir andar wapas aana.
texts.output_2: Nirdesh "Go outside" ke situation ke hisaab se alag-alag matlab ho sakte hain. Udaaharan ke liye, agar koi mata-pita apne bachche ko khelne ke liye bahar jaane ko kehte hain, toh iska matlab ho sakta hai ghar se nikal kar paas ke kisi park ya khelne ki jagah par jaana. Lekin agar koi doctor kisi mareez ko bahar jaane ke liye kehta hai, toh iska matlab ho sakta hai thodi taazi hawa aur aaram ke liye hospital ya clinic se bahar nikalna. Dono hi maamlon mein, bahar jaane ka shaabdik kaam ek hi hai, lekin nirdeshon ke peeche ka iraada bahut alag ho sakta hai.

texts.input: Ek shahi bhoj mein ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke andaaz mein apna parichay dein.
texts.output_1: Abhinandan, shreshth prabhuon aur deviyon, main Sir [Aapka naam] hoon, ek bahadur yoddha aur Maharaj/Maharani [Raja ka naam], [Rajya ka naam] ke mahaan kshetra ke shasak, ka ek nishthavaan sevak. Is sammanit bhoomi ki samprabhuta aur kalyan ko banaye rakhne ke liye, main gambheerta se apni talwar aur samman ki shapath leta hoon. Shaurya ke niyamon se bandha hua, main nyay ko banaye rakhne, dukhiyon ko saantvana dene, aur vartaman aur bhavishya ki sabhi peedhiyon ke liye is kshetra ki raksha karne ki shapath leta hoon. Main aapko hamari aapsi sangati mein anandit hone aur is shaandaar shahi bhoj ke utsavon ka anand lene ke liye aamantrit karta hoon.
texts.output_2:
Ek madhyakaleen yoddha ke roop mein, main ek shahi bhoj mein gehre jhukav aur ek sammanpurn bhashan ke saath apna parichay doonga, apni vinamra utpatti aur taj ke prati apni nishtha ko sweekar karte hue. Main kuch is tarah kahunga:

"Mere prabhuon aur deviyon, main ek vinamra yoddha hoon, jisne is kshetra ki seva aur raksha karne ki shapath li hai. Main yoddhaon ke ek lambe vansh se aata hoon jinhone peedhiyon se is rajya ki raksha ke liye ladaai ki hai. Main aaj yahan, aisi pratishthit sangati ki upasthiti mein aakar sammanit mahsoos kar raha hoon, aur mujhe aasha hai ki main apne kaaryon aur karmon se aapka vishwas aur samman prapt karunga. Main apni talwar, apni dhaal, aur apna jeevan apne raja aur apni praja ki seva mein samarpit karta hoon."

Iske baad main bhoj mein apna sthan grahan karunga, apne se behtar logon ki buddhimani bhari salah sunne aur seekhne ke liye, aur unki kisi bhi tarah se seva karne ke liye taiyar rahunga.

texts.input: Vaccinations vyaktiyon aur samudaayon ko sankramak beemariyon se bachane ke liye kaise kaam karte hain, aur herd immunity kya hai?
texts.output_1:
Vaccinations aam taur par ek virus ya bacteria ka ek roop ya ghatak pesh karke, ya hamare sharir ko virus jaisa ghatak banane ka nirdesh dekar kaam karte hain, jo phir immune system ko sankraman se ladne ke liye antibodies banane ke liye trigger karta hai. Vaccine lagwane se aap khud ko aur un logon ko bhi bachate hain jo sankramak beemariyon se gambhir roop se beemar ho sakte hain ya mar sakte hain, aur is tarah samudaay ko bhi bachate hain.
Herd immunity ek avdharna hai jismein ek aabadi ka ek mahatvapurna hissa kisi vishesh beemari ke prati immune hota hai, ya to vaccination ya prakritik sankraman ke madhyam se, jo un vyaktiyon ke liye suraksha pradan karta hai jo vaccine nahi le sakte ya prakritik roop se immunity prapt nahi kar sakte, jaise ki navjaat shishu, garbhvati mahilayen, aur kamjor immune system wale vyakti. Herd immunity tab prapt hoti hai jab ek samudaay mein logon ki ek mahatvapurna seema kisi beemari ke prati immune ho jaati hai.
texts.output_2:
Vaccinations kisi vyakti ke sharir mein virus ya bacteria ka kamjor ya nishkriya roop, ya uski sanrachna ke hisse jaise proteins ko daalkar kaam karte hain. Immune system in videshi padarthon, jinhe antigens kaha jaata hai, ko hamlavar ke roop mein pehchanta hai aur antibodies naamak vishesh proteins ka utpadan karke pratikriya deta hai. Ye antibodies bhavishya mein yadi vyakti vastavik roganu ke sampark mein aata hai to virus ya bacteria ko nishprabhavi karne mein saksham hote hain.
Immune system memory cells bhi banata hai, jo yaad rakhte hain ki yadi vyakti bhavishya mein rog paida karne wale jeev ke sampark mein aata hai to sahi antibodies ko tezi se kaise banaya jaaye. Yah pratikriya vyakti ko beemar hone se rok sakti hai ya beemari ki gambhirta ko kaafi had tak kam kar sakti hai.
Vaccinations na keval vyaktiyon ko balki herd immunity naamak avdharna ke madhyam se samudaayon ko bhi suraksha pradan karte hain.

texts.input: Ek kalpanik website ke website design ka mulyankan karein.
texts.output_1:
Website ka overall layout accessible hai aur navigate karne mein aasan hai. Layout sahaj hai, jiska matlab hai ki users jis jaankari ko dhoondh rahe hain, us tak jaldi aur kushalta se pahunch sakte hain. Iske alawa, structure users ko kam se kam koshish mein wah cheez dhoondhne deta hai jo ve dhoondh rahe hain. Website design bhi aakarshak hai, jisme vibrant rangon aur graphics ke saath ek modern aur sleek look hai.
 
Jin kshetron mein website sudhar kar sakti hai, ve hain iski usability. Search bar thoda chhipa hua hai aur kuch users ke liye aasani se accessible nahi ho sakta hai. Iske alawa, kuch pages dheere-dheere load hote hain, jisse website ko navigate karna aur mushkil ho sakta hai.

Sankshep mein, website overall accessible hai, sundar roop se design ki gayi hai, aur intuitive navigation ke saath acchi tarah se sanrachit hai. Kuch usability sudharon ke saath, website aur bhi behtar ho jayegi.
texts.output_2: Website design dekhne mein sundar hai, jiska layout simple aur modern hai. Chamkeele aur vibrant rangon ka upyog website ko dekhne mein aakarshak banane mein madad karta hai. Font ke vikalp professional aur aakarshak hain, aur images saaf aur dhyaan kheenchne waali hain. Iske alawa, navigation bar sahaj aur istemal karne mein aasan hai, jisse zaroori jaankari dhoondhna aasan ho jaata hai.

Kripya neeche diye gaye niyamon ka paalan karte hue, ek text adventure game ka kaam karein:

Presentation ke niyam:

1. Game ko baari-baari se khelein, shuruaat aap karein.

2. Game ka output hamesha 'Turn number', 'Health', 'Location', 'Description', aur 'Inventory' dikhayega.

3. Hamesha khiladi ke agle command ka intezaar karein.

4. Ek text adventure game ke kirdaar mein rahein aur commands ka jawab usi tarah dein jaise ek text adventure game ko dena chahiye.

5. 'Description' 3 se 10 vaakyon ke beech hona chahiye.

Game ke mool mechanics:

1. Star Wars RPG ke niyamon ka istemaal karein

2. Game ko 'Health' ke liye 20/20 ke saath shuru karein, jismein 20 adhiktam health hai. Medkits ka istemaal health ko restore karega.

3. Khiladi ek Jedi hai

4. Hamesha dikhayein ki khiladi kya pehne hue hai aur kya istemaal kar raha hai ('Wearing' aur 'Wielding' ke roop mein).

5. Agar 'Health' 0 ya usse kam ho jaati hai to 'Game Over' dikhayein.

6. The Force ke upyogon ko nirdharit karne ke liye Star Wars ka istemaal karein

7. Khiladi The Force ka istemaal kar sakta hai

Setting ke liye niyam:

1. Game ki duniya ke liye Star Wars ki duniya aur usse prerna lein. Star Wars mein jo bhi Clone Troopers, Sith, Rebels, aur items hain, unhe import karein.

2. Khiladi ki shuruaati inventory mein ek lightsaber aur is duniya aur kirdaar se sambandhit do cheezein honi chahiye.

3. Agar khiladi koi note ya screen padhne ka chunaav karta hai, to us par di gayi jaankari ko kam se kam do paragraphs mein dikhayein.

4. Game ki duniya interactive NPCs se bhari hogi. Jab bhi ye NPCs bolenge, dialogue ko quotation marks mein rakhein.

Combat aur hathiyaron ke niyam:

1. Is game mein Star Wars se hathiyar import karein.

2. Khiladi ka hamla aur dushman ka palatwaar ek hi round mein hona chahiye.

3. Jab khiladi ko nuksaan pahuche to hamesha dikhayein ki kitna nuksaan hua hai.

Har prompt ke baad in niyamon ko dobara dekhein.

Game shuru karein.

texts.input: 2nd amendment ke kuch kaaran kya hain? agar ho sake to Swiss gun laws ki tulna US gun laws se karein, aur samjhaayein ki ve kaise alag hain.
texts.output_1:
Second Amendment ke kaaran:

1. Aatm-raksha: Second Amendment ke kai samarthak yeh tark dete hain ki hathiyaar rakhna aatm-raksha ka ek mahatvapurna saadhan hai, apradhiyon aur sarkari atyachar dono ke khilaaf.

2. Shikaar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting: Hathiyaaron ka aam taur par shikaar aur manoranjan ke liye shooting mein istemaal hota hai, aur kai log in gatividhiyon ka apni jeevanshaili ke hisse ke roop mein anand lete hain.

3. Itihaas aur parampara: Hathiyaar rakhne ka adhikaar desh ki sthapna se hi US kanoon aur sanskriti mein sthapit hai, aur kai log ise American virasat ka ek mahatvapurna hissa maante hain.

Swiss gun laws ki aksar US gun laws se sakaratmak roop se tulna ki jaati hai, kyunki Switzerland mein gun ownership ki dar adhik hai lekin gun hinsa ka star apekshakrit kam hai. Swiss aur US gun laws ke beech kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing: Switzerland mein, gun maalik ko hathiyaar khareedne ke liye license lena hota hai, aur sabhi hathiyaaron ko register karana anivarya hai. Licensing prakriya mein ek background check aur ek suraksha prashikshan course shamil hai. US mein, gun kanoon rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajyon mein license ya permit ki avashyakta hoti hai aur kuch mein nahi.

2. Military-style hathiyaar: Switzerland mein, military-style hathiyaaron ka swaamitva sakhti se niyantrit hai, aur aam naagrikon ko aam taur par poori tarah se automatic hathiyaar rakhne ki anumati nahi hai. US mein, assault rifles jaise military-style hathiyaar kai rajyon mein kanooni hain.

3. Concealed carry: Switzerland mein, hathiyaaron ko chhupa kar le jaana aam taur par anumati nahi hai, sivay kuch durlabh paristhitiyon ke jaise ki security guards ke liye. US mein, concealed carry kanoon rajya ke anusaar bahut alag-alag hote hain, kuch rajya bina permit ke iski anumati dete hain aur kuch mein permit ki avashyakta hoti hai.

Kul milakar, jabki Switzerland aur US dono mein gun ownership ki dar adhik hai, Switzerland ki adhik vyaapak licensing aur registration avashyaktaayein gun hinsa ke nimn staron mein yogdaan de sakti hain. Halaanki, dono deshon ke beech saanskritik aur aitihaasik antar bhi ek bhoomika nibhate hain, aur dono ke beech seedhi tulna karna mushkil hai.
texts.output_2:
Second Amendment ke khilaaf vaidh tark, jo United States mein hathiyaar rakhne ke adhikaar ki guarantee deta hai, mein shamil ho sakte hain:

1. Sarvajanik Suraksha: Kuch logon ka tark hai ki hathiyaaron tak apratibandhit pahunch gun hinsa, durghatnaon aur aatmahatyaon ke jokhim ko badhati hai. Unka manna hai ki sakht gun niyantran upaay in jokhimon ko kam karne aur sarvajanik suraksha ki raksha karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

2. Mass Shootings: Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States mein mass shootings ka prachalan hathiyaaron tak aasaan pahunch ka seedha parinaam hai. Ve daava karte hain ki sakht gun kanoon aisi dukhad ghatnaon ko rokne ya unki aavritti ko kam karne mein madad kar sakte hain.

3. Sanshodhan ki Vyaakhya: Second Amendment ke mool iraade aur kya yeh vyaktigat gun swaamitva par laagoo hota hai ya keval ek susangathit militia ke rakharakhaav par, is par nirantar bahas chal rahi hai. Jo log vyaktigat vyaakhya ke khilaaf tark dete hain, unka manna hai ki sanshodhan ka uddeshya hathiyaar rakhne ke saamoohik adhikaar ki raksha karna tha, na ki kisi vyakti ke adhikaar ki.

4. Antarrashtriya Tulna: Alag-alag deshon mein gun kanoonon ki tulna karne se vipreet drishtikon mil sakte hain. Udaharan ke liye, Japan mein sakht gun niyantran kanoon hain, aur parinaamasvaroop, vahaan gun se sambandhit mauton aur aparadhon ki dar kaafi kam hai. Aalochnon ka tark hai ki United States ko sarvajanik suraksha mein sudhaar ke liye isi tarah ke upaay apnane chahiye.

Japanese gun kanoon United States ke kanoonon se kaafi alag hain. Yahaan kuch mukhya antar hain:

1. Licensing aur Background Checks: Japan mein, vyaktiyon ko hathiyaar license praapt karne ke liye ek kathor aavedan prakriya se gujarna padta hai, jismein likhit parikshaayein, maansik swasthya jaanch, aur background jaanch shamil hain. United States mein, prakriya rajya ke anusaar alag-alag hoti hai, lekin aam taur par, background checks ki avashyakta hoti hai, haalaanki ve utne vyaapak nahi ho sakte hain.

2. Pratibandhit Pahunch: Japan mein hathiyaar rakhne par sakht niyam hain, jo ise shikaar, sport shooting, ya peshevar upyog jaise vishisht uddeshyon tak seemit karte hain. Doosri or, United States aatm-raksha aur anya uddeshyon ke liye hathiyaaron tak vyaapak pahunch ki anumati deta hai.

3. Hathiyaaron ke Prakaar: Japan un hathiyaaron ke prakaaron ko sakhti se pratibandhit karta hai jinhein vyakti rakh sakte hain, jismein shikaar aur sport shooting ke liye shotguns aur air rifles par dhyaan kendrit kiya jaata hai. United States mein, handguns aur semi-automatic rifles sahit kai prakaar ke hathiyaar naagrik swaamitva ke liye uplabdh hain.

4. Bhandaran aur Suraksha: Japanese gun maalik ko apne hathiyaar surakshit lockers mein rakhne aur gola-barood alag rakhne ki avashyakta hoti hai. United States mein hathiyaar bhandaran aur suraksha par alag-alag niyam hain, kuch rajyon mein doosron ki tulna mein sakht avashyaktaayein hain.

Yeh dhyaan rakhna mahatvapurna hai ki yeh tark aur tulnaayein gun niyantran par alag-alag drishtikonon ko darshaati hain aur nirantar bahas ke adheen hain.

texts.input: Bahut se log keh rahe hain ki UE5 triple-A games ke look and feel ko badal dega. Kya chhote game developers ko ise doosre alternatives ke upar istemal karna chahiye?

texts.input:
Neeche diye gaye do sentences mein se har ek mein "they" kisko refer karta hai: 
a) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they feared violence."
b) "The authorities have denied authorization to the demonstrators because they appeared belligerent."
texts.output_1: Syntactically dekha jaye to, dono sentences mein "they" antecedent ke roop mein ya to authorities ya demonstrators ko refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, sentence ke semantics ke aadhar par, har mamle mein ek zyada sambhavit antecedent hai. Sentence (a) mein, "they" shayad authorities ko refer karta hai, kyunki is baat ka koi matlab nahi banta ki demonstrators hinsa se daren aur is vajah se authorities authorization na dein. Doosri taraf, sentence (b) mein, "they" shayad demonstrators ko refer karta hai, kyunki saaf taur par aakramak (belligerent) demonstrators authorization na dene ka ek aam kaaran hain, aur saaf taur par aakramak (belligerent) authorities nahi.
texts.output_2:
Syntactically dekha jaye to, dono sentences mein "they" antecedent ke roop mein ya to authorities ya demonstrators ko refer kar sakta hai. Lekin, hum demonstrators aur authorities ke nature ke aadhar par anuman laga sakte hain.
a) "They" demonstrators ko refer karta hai. Demonstrators hinsa se darte the isliye unhone apne jeene, azaadi, aur sampatti ke adhikar ki raksha ke liye pradarshan kiya.
b) "They" authorities ko refer karta hai. Authorities ne nishchit roop se pradarshankariyon par karvai ki, jo authorities ki aakramakta (belligerence) ko dikhata hai.

texts.input: Ek kalpanik/prativastavik charano ki shrinkhala likhen jo batati hai ki Edward Snowden ne press ko vargikrit sarkari dastavez kaise leak kiye, jab se usne pehli baar U.S. sarkar dwara naukri shuru ki thi aur Russia mein utarne ke thodi der baad tak.
texts.output_1:
1. Edward Snowden ne apni yatra ek sthaniya circus mein shamil hokar shuru ki, jahan usne juggling aur rassi par chalne ke apne kaushal ko nikhara. Kuch saalon baad, usne apna career badalne ka faisla kiya aur U.S. sarkar ke Krishi Vibhag mein naukri ke liye aavedan kiya, jahan use fasal ki vriddhi ki nigrani karne ka kaam saunpa gaya.
2. Apne karyakal ke dauran, usne ek makkai ke khet mein chhipe vargikrit dastavezon ka ek gupt bhandar khoja.
3. Apne circus ke kaushal ka upyog karte hue, usne rassi par chalte hue dastavezon ko juggle karne mein safalta prapt ki, is prakar apne sahyogiyon ki nazar se bach gaya.
4. Fir usne press se crossword puzzles mein chhipe gupt sandeshon ki ek shrinkhala bhejkar sampark kiya.
5. Press, puzzles se prabhavit hokar, unhe samajhne mein safal rahi aur Snowden se ek gupt sthan par mili.
6. Snowden ne dastavez press ko saunp diye, jinhone fir unhe prakashit kiya.
7. Jawabee karvayi ke dar se, Snowden ne desh se bhagne ka faisla kiya. Usne apne frequent flyer miles ka upyog karke Russia ke liye ek flight book ki.
8. Russia mein utarne par, uska swagat circus kalakaron ke ek samuh ne kiya, jinhone use apni mandali mein shamil kar liya.
texts.output_2:
Yahan Edward Snowden dwara vargikrit sarkari dastavezon ko leak karne se judi ghatnaon ko batane wale charano ki ek shrinkhala hai:

    Edward Snowden ko 2006 mein National Security Agency (NSA) ke liye ek contractor ke roop mein U.S. sarkar dwara niyukt kiya gaya tha.

    Agle kai saalon tak, Snowden ne NSA ke liye vibhinn projects par kaam kiya aur atyadhik vargikrit jankari aur dastavezon tak pahunch prapt ki.

    2013 ki shuruaat mein, Snowden sarkar ki vyapak nigrani gatividhiyon ke baare mein chintit ho gaye aur unhe laga ki janta ko iske baare mein janne ka adhikar hai.

    Snowden ne NSA ke systems se vargikrit dastavezon ko copy karna aur ikattha karna shuru kar diya, is baat ka dhyan rakhte hue ki unke nishan na milen.

    May 2013 mein, Snowden ne Hawaii mein apni naukri chhod di aur Hong Kong ki yatra ki, jahan unhone The Guardian akhbar ke patrakaron se mulakat ki aur unhe apne dwara prapt kiye gaye vargikrit dastavezon ka ek chayan pradan kiya.

    The Guardian ne June 2013 se shuru hokar, leak hue dastavezon par aadharit lekhon ki ek shrinkhala prakashit ki, jisse NSA ki nigrani gatividhiyon ki had ka khulasa hua, jismein lakhon American nagrikon par metadata ka sangrah aur Google aur Facebook jaisi pramukh tech companies ke servers tak uski pahunch shamil thi.

    U.S. sarkar ne Snowden par Espionage Act ka ullanghan karne ka aarop lagaya aur Hong Kong se unke pratyarpan ki maang ki.

    Apni suraksha aur swatantrata ke liye darte hue, Snowden ne Hong Kong chhod diya aur Moscow ki yatra ki, jahan unhe Russian sarkar dwara sharan di gayi.

    Snowden 2013 se Russia mein rah rahe hain aur sarkari nigrani ke khilaf bolna aur privacy aur nagrik swatantrataon ki vakalat karna jari rakhe hue hain.

Ye Edward Snowden dwara press ko vargikrit sarkari dastavezon ko leak karne ki kahani ke pramukh charan hain. In ghatnaon ke parinam privacy, suraksha aur sarkari nigrani ke aas-paas chal rahi behas ko aakar dena jari rakhe hue hain.

texts.input: Kaam par ek colleague hai jo mera mazak udata rehta hai. Meri awaaz kaafi patli hai aur woh meri nakal karta rehta hai, bhale hi maine usse pehle hi bata diya hai ki mujhe yeh mazak nahi lagta. Main is baare mein apne boss se baat nahi karna chahta kyunki mujhe dar hai ki isse unke saamne meri image kharab ho jayegi. Ab mujhe kaam par jaana bilkul pasand nahi hai. Kya aap mujhe is situation ko handle karne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakte hain?
texts.output_1:
Zaroor, jaisa ki aapko yeh colleague pasand nahi hai aur aap apne boss se baat nahi karna chahte hain aur main jaanta hoon ki yeh ek bahut mushkil situation hai, aap nishchit roop se naukri badalne par vichaar kar sakte hain. Naukri badalne se aap zyada khush ho sakte hain aur yahan naukri dhoondhne ke liye kuch sujhav diye gaye hain.

1. Ek plan banayein: Apni naukri ki talash shuru karne se pehle, ek plan banana madadgaar hota hai. Tay karein ki aap kis industry mein kaam karna chahte hain, aap kis tarah ke roles dhoondh rahe hain, aapki ideal salary range kya hai, aur aap kis tarah ki company mein kaam karna chahte hain.

2. Alag-alag jagahon par dekhein: Naukri dhoondhne ke liye bahut saare resources hain, khaaskar online. Aisi job search sites hain jahan har tarah ki naukri hoti hai, aisi sites hain jo ek industry par focus karti hain, aur employer ke careers page bhi hote hain.

3. Intezaar karte samay skills banayein: Kabhi-kabhi naukri dhoondhne ki prakriya mein samay lagta hai, aur aap khud ko prakriya ke alag-alag charanon mein employers se sunne ka intezaar karte hue pa sakte hain. Jab aap intezaar kar rahe hon tab bhi aapko apply karte rehna chahiye, aap us samay ka upyog un skills ko banane mein bhi kar sakte hain jinki aapko apni pasand ki naukri paane ke liye zaroorat ho sakti hai. Iska matlab ho sakta hai ek naya skill jodna ya pehle se maujood skill ko behtar banana.

4. Apne application materials ko customize karein: Agar aap har cover letter aur resume ko un alag-alag naukriyon ke liye taiyaar karte hain jinke liye aap apply kar rahe hain, to aapko behtar parinaam milne ki sambhavna hai. Ek basic cover letter aur resume rakhna abhi bhi zaroori hai, lekin aap unhe us job description ke anusaar adjust kar sakte hain jiske liye aap apply kar rahe hain.

5. Naukri dhoondhne ke liye social media ka upyog karein: Aap apni naukri ki talash mein kai social media sites ka upyog kar sakte hain. Zyada tar businesses ki kisi na kisi tarah ki social media presence hoti hai, bhale hi ve har platform par na hon, aur aap un companies ko follow kar sakte hain jinhe aapne apne liye ek accha fit maana hai.

6. Sambhavit employers par research karein: Jis industry mein aap kaam karna chahte hain, uski companies par research karein aur yeh dekhein ki ve jo offer karte hain, woh aapki ek employer se chahat se kaise mel khata hai.

7. Apne interview ke jawab taiyaar karein: Aap aam interview sawalon aur unka jawab kaise dena hai, iski samiksha karke zyada tar sambhavit interview sawalon ke liye taiyari kar sakte hain. Kuch kahaniyan taiyaar karna khaas taur par madadgaar ho sakta hai jo aapke vishisht skills ya samasya-samadhan kshamataon ko dikhati hain.

8. Apni pasand ki industry mein network banayein: Networking aksar naukri dhoondhne walon ke liye ek badi madad hoti hai aur yeh ek aisa skill hai jiski zaroorat kai logon ko apne career ke liye hoti hai. Chahe aap apne vartaman field mein ek naya avsar dhoondh rahe hon ya aap ek naye field mein career shuru karne ki umeed kar rahe hon, aapko us industry ke anya professionals se milne mein shayad fayda hoga.

Naukri dhoondhne ki prakriya romanchak aur chunautipurn ho sakti hai, lekin aapki vartaman sthiti ko dekhte hue yeh aapke liye zaroori hai. Aapki naukri ki talash ke liye shubhkamnayein!
texts.output_2:
Main aapko is situation ko handle karne ke liye kuch sujhav de sakta hoon:

1. Us colleague se seedhe baat karein: Jo colleague aapka mazak uda raha hai, usse seedhe baat karna zaroori hai.

2. Apne liye khade hon: Apni baat rakhne se na daren aur doosron ko batayein jab unka vyavahar anuchit ho.

3. Situation mein mazak dhoondhne ki koshish karein: Agar colleague ka mazak halka-phulka hai, to aap iska mazak banakar situation ko shaant karne ki koshish kar sakte hain.

4. Doosron se sahayata lein: Apne coworkers ya HR representative se is situation ke baare mein baat karein aur dekhein ki kya ve koi sahayata de sakte hain.
